* '''Decipher''' published the game (1995–2001). As-printed text and Decipher errata are the historical card.
* '''Players Committee''' later issued errata and virtual cards for organized play. Those are a popular, well-documented later ruleset — not “the card,” and not published by Decipher.
* '''This site''' (swccg.com / wiki.swccg.com) is a fan encyclopedia and play table. It stores those layers separately so they do not collapse.

See [[Players Committee]] and [[GEMP]].
